English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false A picture taken by Virat Kohli with his wife at Knuckles, Sri Lanka? False A search through Google Reverse Image revealed that it was not a photo taken in Sri Lanka. by Anonymous | August 6, 2024 by Anonymous | 6 August 2024 There were posts repeatedly being shared on social media about the Indian cricketer Virat Kohli, who shared a picture on social media that he along with his wife is visiting the Dust Falls in Knuckles, Sri Lanka. As this news was being rapidly shared on social media, factseeker looked into the matter. A search through Google Reverse Image revealed that it was not a photo taken in Sri Lanka. The photo was taken by Virat Kohli and his wife in 2019 when they were on vacation in Bhutan. Virat Kohli’s wife Anushka Sharma’s post on Instagram suggests that this photo was taken in Bhutan. https://shorturl.at/s71Ww Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase? We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
